title: Index
slide_intent: Help readers move from a design question to a numbered manual section. Grouping topics by the work at hand shortens the search for a specific instruction.
strategic_value: NASA can connect a rule about its identity with the production page needed to use it. Separate groups cover logotype rules, reproduction art, stationery, forms and publications.
demonstration: The first index page gives the effective date above a ruled list. Numbered section names occupy the left column, titles and dotted leaders fill the middle, and section references align at right.
practical_value: Choose the section group, then follow the individual reference for a rule, a master or an application.

content_islands.name: Index heading and scope
content_islands.spec: Place Index and the short effective-date notice at the top, apart from the listings.

content_islands.name: Section directory
content_islands.spec: Group the introduction and sections 1–5 in sequence. Pair each title with its section reference and separate groups by thin rules.
